coverage.qualification: Relocated/refactored legacy source and inventory units are fully covered and retain meaningful original assertions. The new tokenizer retains one documented unexecuted64MiB defensive text-size guard. All new class/callable statement coverage is at least 90%. No unchanged predecessor suite was repeated.

downstream_interfaces.declarations: declaration_candidates(path: str, text: str, *, include_members: bool=True, max_tokens: int=100000) -> tuple[Detection,...] returns sorted namespace/type/record/delegate/event syntax plus optional inferred direct members. One max(32,4*token_count) private counter bounds all overlapping lookahead. SourceScanError.code identifies source-work-limit, source-declaration, token/encoding errors; failed files emit no partial claims.
downstream_interfaces.legacy: classify_text(path: str,text: str) -> list[Detection] preserves the original declaration/event catalog and heuristic metadata. DotnetInventoryAnalyzer(fs=None) parses once into private captured-byte carriers, maps hashes from the same payload without rereads, and rejects direct emit in favor of guarded v2 publication. The old modules are identity-preserving re-exports.
downstream_interfaces.source_text: strip_comments_and_strings(text: str) -> str preserves decoded character offsets and every CR/LF while blanking comments, chars, regular/verbatim/raw strings and entire interpolation expressions. numbered_lines(text: str) -> list[tuple[int,str]] uses CRLF/CR/LF physical boundaries and preserves a final empty line. All eight legacy exports retain canonical object identity; six evidence/carrier executable AST contracts and positional/default constructors are unchanged.
downstream_interfaces.subscriptions: subscription_candidates(path: str, text: str, *, max_tokens: int=100000) -> tuple[Detection,...] extracts possible handler assignments with operator/handler/offset/end_line metadata. Every relationship stays inferred, unresolved and potentially arithmetic; no runtime activation or event binding is established.
downstream_interfaces.tokens: decode_source(content: bytes, *, max_bytes: int=67108864) -> str accepts strict UTF-8 with optional BOM or BOM UTF-16/32, rejects invalid encodings/NUL/size. tokenize_csharp(masked_text: str, *, max_tokens: int=100000) -> tuple[Token,...] retains literal Unicode/verbatim/escaped spelling and decoded-character offsets. Frozen Token has value/start/end/line/identifier; end is exclusive. No compiler normalization, preprocessing evaluation or byte-offset claim.
downstream_interfaces.v2_adapters: CSharpDeclarationAnalyzer.identifier=csharp-symbols and EventSubscriptionAnalyzer.identifier=event-subscriptions expose analyze(capture: InventoryCapture) -> Analysis. They consume only captured bytes/pins, have no I/O/publication, classify facts vs inference, downgrade unmatched pins and bound records. Diagnostics preserve per-file failures and unresolved compiler/preprocessor semantics. Direct construction is tested; public registry selection is deferred to P4-T9.
